title: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography
method: Unsteady Flamelet Generated Manifold (UFGM) CFD + 3D two-color DSLR tomography
objective_summary: Develops and validates unsteady flamelet generated manifold (UFGM) simulations of concurrent solid-fuel flame spread in microgravity, benchmarked directly against NASA BASS and BASS-II PMMA and wax experiments.

title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets
method: Computational soot & radiation modeling across 1,600+ raw DSLR flame images
objective_summary: Integrates computational soot models with over 1,600 raw DSLR images from the ISS SPICE dataset to derive temperature distributions, soot volume fractions, and smoke-point behavior in 0g vs. 1g.

title: Utilization of the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment Data for Advanced Modeling and Simulation of Smoke Generation in Micro-Gravity
method: Direct Numerical Simulation (Navier-Stokes nodal aerosol dynamics)
objective_summary: Uses direct numerical simulation in a SAME-like cross-flow geometry to quantify how microgravity vs. Earth buoyancy changes pyrolysis smoke wake structure, thermophoresis, and particle size growth.

title: Effect of External Thermo-Convective Perturbation on Cool Flame Dynamics: A Multidimensional Multi-Physics CFD Analysis
method: OpenFOAM 3D multi-physics CFD with coupled low-temperature chemistry and radiation
objective_summary: Uses ISS FLEX flight data from PSI to model 3D n-alkane droplet cool flames, mapping stability windows for sustained oscillation, hot-flame transition, drift-induced convection, and extinction.

title: Quantitative Studies of Cool Flame Transitions at Radiation / Stretch Extinction Using Counterflow Flames
objective_summary: Uses ISS FLEX experimental conditions from PSI to map flammability and radiation/stretch extinction boundaries separating hot flames and diffusional cool flames across oxygen and pressure levels.
